title: Lucas and Grandma
text:
Lucas and his grandmother live in the same house. Every Sunday, they cook lunch together. His grandmother teaches him old family recipes. Lucas likes her stories about when she was young.

Last month, Lucas was angry because he forgot her birthday. He felt bad and did not know what to say. So he wrote her a long letter with a drawing. His grandmother smiled and hugged him.

paragraph_translations: Lucas e a avó moram na mesma casa. Todo domingo, eles cozinham o almoço juntos. A avó ensina a ele receitas antigas da família. Lucas gosta das histórias dela sobre quando ela era jovem.
No mês passado, Lucas ficou zangado porque esqueceu o aniversário dela. Ele se sentiu mal e não sabia o que dizer. Então, escreveu para ela uma carta longa com um desenho. A avó sorriu e o abraçou.
